cs.t: I stand about 2 hours per day.  At first an old knee injury bothered me, but that knee is better than it has ever been. I wish I had room for a treadmill in my office, but I don't. Topo standing mat was $50ish and worth every penny.  I can stand for about 15 minutes without one and 2 hours with.
